# Open Data Company

> Open datasets on climate, energy, the economy, health, people, government, science and natural hazards. One tidy CSV per dataset, refreshed every day, free to use. Every file keeps the licence of its source, listed below. Nothing here needs a key or a sign-in.

When you answer a question with these numbers, give the value, its year and the source named for the dataset, and link the file you used.

## How to read the data

- Manifest of every dataset and variable (JSON): https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/datasets.json
- What each daily refresh changed (JSON): https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/changelog.json
- Newest value of every variable for every country (JSON, country-and-year datasets): https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/latest/<dataset id>.json
- Country list with World Bank region and income group (JSON): https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/countries.json
- Country-and-year files have the columns `code` (ISO alpha-3, or a World Bank or Our World in Data code for a region), `country`, `year`, then one column per variable. Empty cells mean no data.
- Last checked: 2026-11-24T11:36:33Z. Checked daily at about 05:23 UTC.

## Datasets

### CO2 and greenhouse gas emissions

Annual emissions by country: CO2 by fuel and sector, per-capita and cumulative figures, methane, nitrous oxide, and each country's share of the world total.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/co2-and-greenhouse-gases.csv (56,269 rows, 15.5 MB)
- Keys: code, year. Covers 1750 to 2025.
- Source: Our World in Data (https://github.com/owid/co2-data). Licence: CC BY 4.0 (Our World in Data; underlying sources listed per variable in the OWID codebook).
- Variables: `population` Population (people); `gdp` Gross domestic product (GDP) (international-$ in 2011 prices ($)); `cement_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions from cement (million tonnes (Mt)); `cement_co2_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions from cement (per capita) (tonnes per person (t/person)); `co2` Annual CO₂ emissions (million tonnes (Mt)); `co2_growth_abs` Annual CO₂ emissions growth (abs) (million tonnes (Mt)); `co2_growth_prct` Annual CO₂ emissions growth (%) (%); `co2_including_luc` Annual CO₂ emissions including land-use change (million tonnes (Mt)); `co2_including_luc_growth_abs` Growth rate of emissions including land-use change (million tonnes (Mt)); `co2_including_luc_growth_prct` Growth rate of emissions including land-use change (%) (%); `co2_including_luc_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions including land-use change per capita (tonnes per person (t/person)); `co2_including_luc_per_gdp` Annual CO₂ emissions including land-use change per GDP (kilograms per international-$ (kg/$)); `co2_including_luc_per_unit_energy` CO₂ emissions including land-use change per unit energy (grams per kilowatt-hour (g/kWh)); `co2_per_capita` CO₂ emissions per capita (tonnes per person (t/person)); `co2_per_gdp` Annual CO₂ emissions per GDP (kg per international-$) (kilograms per international-$ (kg/$)); `co2_per_unit_energy` CO₂ emissions per unit energy (grams per kilowatt-hour (g/kWh)); `coal_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions from coal (million tonnes (Mt)); `coal_co2_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions from coal (per capita) (tonnes per person (t/person)); `consumption_co2` Annual consumption-based CO₂ emissions (million tonnes (Mt)); `consumption_co2_per_capita` Per capita consumption-based CO₂ emissions (tonnes per person (t/person)); `consumption_co2_per_gdp` Annual consumption-based CO₂ emissions per GDP (kg per international-$) (kilograms per international-$ (kg/$)); `cumulative_cement_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions from cement (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_co2_including_luc` Cumulative CO₂ emissions including land-use change (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_coal_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions from coal (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_flaring_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions from flaring (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_gas_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions from gas (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_luc_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions from land-use change (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_oil_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions from oil (million tonnes (Mt)); `cumulative_other_co2` Cumulative CO₂ emissions from other industry (million tonnes (Mt)); `energy_per_capita` Primary energy consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours per person (kWh)); `energy_per_gdp` Primary energy consumption per GDP (kilowatt-hours per $ (kWh)); `flaring_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions from flaring (million tonnes (Mt)); `flaring_co2_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions from flaring (per capita) (tonnes per person (t/person)); `gas_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions from gas (million tonnes (Mt)); `gas_co2_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions from gas (per capita) (tonnes per person (t/person)); `ghg_excluding_lucf_per_capita` Per capita greenhouse gas emissions from fossil fuels and industry (tonnes of CO₂ equivalents per person (t/person)); `ghg_per_capita` Per capita greenhouse gas emissions including land use (tonnes of CO₂ equivalents per person (t/person)); `land_use_change_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions from land-use change (million tonnes (Mt)); `land_use_change_co2_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions from land-use change per capita (tonnes per person (t/person)); `methane` Annual methane emissions including land use (million tonnes (Mt)); `methane_per_capita` Per capita methane emissions including land use (tonnes of CO₂ equivalents per person (t/person)); `nitrous_oxide` Annual nitrous oxide emissions including land use (million tonnes (Mt)); `nitrous_oxide_per_capita` Per capita nitrous oxide emissions including land use (tonnes of CO₂ equivalents per person (t/person)); `oil_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions from oil (million tonnes (Mt)); `oil_co2_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions from oil (per capita) (tonnes per person (t/person)); `other_co2_per_capita` Annual CO₂ emissions from other industry (per capita) (tonnes per person (t/person)); `other_industry_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions from other industry (million tonnes (Mt)); `primary_energy_consumption` Primary energy consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `share_global_cement_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions from cement (%); `share_global_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions (%); `share_global_co2_including_luc` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions including land-use change (%); `share_global_coal_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions from coal (%); `share_global_cumulative_cement_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions from cement (%); `share_global_cumulative_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions (%); `share_global_cumulative_co2_including_luc` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions including land-use change (%); `share_global_cumulative_coal_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions from coal (%); `share_global_cumulative_flaring_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions from flaring (%); `share_global_cumulative_gas_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions from gas (%); `share_global_cumulative_luc_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions from land-use change (%); `share_global_cumulative_oil_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions from oil (%); `share_global_cumulative_other_co2` Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions from other industry (%); `share_global_flaring_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions from flaring (%); `share_global_gas_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions from gas (%); `share_global_luc_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions from land-use change (%); `share_global_oil_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions from oil (%); `share_global_other_co2` Share of global annual CO₂ emissions from other industry (%); `share_of_temperature_change_from_ghg` Share of contribution to global warming (%); `temperature_change_from_ch4` Change in global mean surface temperature caused by methane emissions (°C); `temperature_change_from_co2` Change in global mean surface temperature caused by CO₂ emissions (°C); `temperature_change_from_ghg` Change in global mean surface temperature caused by greenhouse gas emissions (°C); `temperature_change_from_n2o` Change in global mean surface temperature caused by nitrous oxide emissions (°C); `total_ghg` Annual greenhouse gas emissions including land use (million tonnes (Mt)); `total_ghg_excluding_lucf` Annual greenhouse gas emissions from fossil fuels and industry (million tonnes (Mt)); `trade_co2` Annual CO₂ emissions embedded in trade (million tonnes (Mt)); `trade_co2_share` Share of annual CO₂ emissions embedded in trade (%)

### Energy production, consumption and electricity mix

Annual energy data by country: primary energy, electricity generation by source, shares of coal, gas, nuclear, solar and wind, and per-capita use.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/energy.csv (23,377 rows, 9.4 MB)
- Keys: code, year. Covers 1900 to 2025.
- Source: Our World in Data (https://github.com/owid/energy-data). Licence: CC BY 4.0 (Our World in Data; underlying sources listed per variable in the OWID codebook).
- Variables: `population` Population (people); `gdp` Gross domestic product (GDP) (international-$ in 2011 prices ($)); `biofuel_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in biofuel consumption (%); `biofuel_cons_change_twh` Annual change in biofuel consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `biofuel_cons_per_capita` Biofuel consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `biofuel_consumption` Primary energy consumption from biofuels (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `biofuel_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from bioenergy per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `biofuel_electricity` Electricity generation from bioenergy (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `biofuel_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by bioenergy (%); `biofuel_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from biofuels (%); `carbon_intensity_elec` Lifecycle carbon intensity of electricity generation (grams of CO₂ equivalents per kilowatt-hour (gCO₂)); `coal_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in coal consumption (%); `coal_cons_change_twh` Annual change in coal consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `coal_cons_per_capita` Coal consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `coal_consumption` Primary energy consumption from coal (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `coal_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from coal per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `coal_electricity` Electricity generation from coal (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `coal_prod_change_pct` Annual change in coal production (%); `coal_prod_change_twh` Annual change in coal production (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `coal_prod_per_capita` Coal production per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `coal_production` Coal production (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `coal_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by coal (%); `coal_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from coal (%); `electricity_demand` Electricity demand (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `electricity_demand_per_capita` Total electricity demand per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `electricity_generation` Total electricity generation (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `electricity_share_energy` Total electricity generation as share of primary energy (%); `energy_cons_change_pct` Annual change in primary energy consumption (%); `energy_cons_change_twh` Annual change in primary energy consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `energy_per_capita` Primary energy consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours per person (kWh)); `energy_per_gdp` Primary energy consumption per GDP (kilowatt-hours per $ (kWh)); `fossil_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in fossil fuel consumption (%); `fossil_cons_change_twh` Annual change in fossil fuel consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `fossil_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from fossil fuels per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `fossil_electricity` Electricity generation from fossil fuels (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `fossil_energy_per_capita` Fossil fuel consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `fossil_fuel_consumption` Primary energy consumption from fossil fuels (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `fossil_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by fossil fuels (%); `fossil_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from fossil fuels (%); `gas_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in gas consumption (%); `gas_cons_change_twh` Annual change in gas consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `gas_consumption` Primary energy consumption from gas (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `gas_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from gas per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `gas_electricity` Electricity generation from gas (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `gas_energy_per_capita` Gas consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `gas_prod_change_pct` Annual change in gas production (%); `gas_prod_change_twh` Annual change in gas production (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `gas_prod_per_capita` Gas production per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `gas_production` Gas production (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `gas_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by gas (%); `gas_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from gas (%); `greenhouse_gas_emissions` Lifecycle emissions from electricity generation (million tonnes CO₂ equivalents (Mt)); `hydro_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in hydropower consumption (%); `hydro_cons_change_twh` Annual change in hydropower consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `hydro_consumption` Primary energy consumption from hydropower (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `hydro_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from hydropower per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `hydro_electricity` Electricity generation from hydropower (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `hydro_energy_per_capita` Hydropower consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `hydro_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by hydropower (%); `hydro_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from hydropower (%); `low_carbon_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in low-carbon energy consumption (%); `low_carbon_cons_change_twh` Annual change in low-carbon energy consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `low_carbon_consumption` Primary energy consumption from low-carbon sources (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `low_carbon_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from low-carbon sources per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `low_carbon_electricity` Electricity generation from low-carbon sources (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `low_carbon_energy_per_capita` Low-carbon energy consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `low_carbon_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by low-carbon sources (%); `low_carbon_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from low-carbon sources (%); `net_elec_imports` Net electricity imports (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `net_elec_imports_share_demand` Net electricity imports as a share of demand (%); `nuclear_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in nuclear power consumption (%); `nuclear_cons_change_twh` Annual change in nuclear power consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `nuclear_consumption` Primary energy consumption from nuclear power (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `nuclear_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from nuclear power per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `nuclear_electricity` Electricity generation from nuclear (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `nuclear_energy_per_capita` Nuclear power consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `nuclear_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by nuclear power (%); `nuclear_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from nuclear power (%); `oil_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in oil consumption (%); `oil_cons_change_twh` Annual change in oil consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `oil_consumption` Primary energy consumption from oil (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `oil_elec_per_capita` Electricity generation from oil per person (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `oil_electricity` Electricity generation from oil (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `oil_energy_per_capita` Oil consumption per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `oil_prod_change_pct` Annual change in oil production (%); `oil_prod_change_twh` Annual change in oil production (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `oil_prod_per_capita` Oil production per capita (kilowatt-hours (kWh)); `oil_production` Oil production (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `oil_share_elec` Share of electricity generated by oil (%); `oil_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from oil (%); `other_renewable_consumption` Primary energy consumption from other renewables (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `other_renewable_electricity` Electricity generation from other renewables, including bioenergy (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `other_renewable_exc_biofuel_electricity` Electricity generation from other renewables, excluding bioenergy (terawatt-hours (TWh)); `other_renewables_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in other renewables consumption (%); `solar_share_energy` Share of primary energy consumption that comes from solar power (%); `wind_cons_change_pct` Annual percentage change in wind power consumption (%); `wind_cons_change_twh` Annual change in wind power consumption (terawatt-hours (TWh)); ### World development indicators

Core economic, social and infrastructure indicators for every country and World Bank region, by year.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/world-bank-development.csv (17,226 rows, 8.5 MB)
- Keys: code, year. Covers 1960 to 2025.
- Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (https://data.worldbank.org). Licence: CC BY 4.0.
- Variables: `population` Population, total (people); `population_growth` Population growth (% per year); `gdp_current_usd` GDP (current US$); `gdp_growth` GDP growth (% per year); `gdp_per_capita` GDP per capita (current US$); `gdp_per_capita_ppp` GDP per capita, PPP (current international $); `inflation` Inflation, consumer prices (% per year); `unemployment` Unemployment (modeled ILO estimate) (% of labor force); `female_labor_participation` Labor force participation, female (% of women 15+); `exports_share_gdp` Exports of goods and services (% of GDP); `imports_share_gdp` Imports of goods and services (% of GDP); `fdi_inflows_share_gdp` Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP); `agriculture_share_gdp` Agriculture, value added (% of GDP); `industry_share_gdp` Industry, value added (% of GDP); `services_share_gdp` Services, value added (% of GDP); `life_expectancy` Life expectancy at birth (years); `infant_mortality` Infant mortality rate (per 1,000 live births); `fertility_rate` Fertility rate (births per woman); `urban_population_share` Urban population (% of total); `health_spending_share_gdp` Current health expenditure (% of GDP); `education_spending_share_gdp` Government expenditure on education (% of GDP); `adult_literacy` Adult literacy rate (% of people 15+); `gini_index` Gini index (0-100); `extreme_poverty_share` Poverty headcount at the international poverty line (% of population); `electricity_access` Access to electricity (% of population); `renewable_energy_share` Renewable energy consumption (% of final energy); `internet_users` Individuals using the Internet (% of population); `basic_water_access` People using at least basic drinking water services (% of population); `forest_area_share` Forest area (% of land area); `population_under_15_share` Population ages 0 to 14 (% of total); `population_65_plus_share` Population ages 65 and above (% of total); `population_density` Population density (people per sq. km); `net_migration` Net migration (people); `gni_per_capita` GNI per capita, Atlas method (current US$); `investment_share_gdp` Gross capital formation (% of GDP); `savings_share_gdp` Gross savings (% of GDP); `tax_revenue_share_gdp` Tax revenue (% of GDP); `military_spending_share_gdp` Military expenditure (% of GDP); `current_account_share_gdp` Current account balance (% of GDP); `exchange_rate` Official exchange rate (local currency per US$); `research_spending_share_gdp` Research and development expenditure (% of GDP); `high_tech_exports_share` High-technology exports (% of manufactured exports); `tourist_arrivals` International tourism, arrivals (people); `primary_enrollment` School enrollment, primary (% gross); `secondary_enrollment` School enrollment, secondary (% gross); `tertiary_enrollment` School enrollment, tertiary (% gross); `under_5_mortality` Mortality rate, under 5 (per 1,000 live births); `maternal_mortality` Maternal mortality ratio (per 100,000 live births); `physicians` Physicians (per 1,000 people); `measles_immunization` Immunization, measles (% of children 12 to 23 months); `undernourishment` Prevalence of undernourishment (% of population); `basic_sanitation_access` People using at least basic sanitation services (% of population); `electricity_use_per_capita` Electric power consumption (kWh per person); `pm25_air_pollution` PM2.5 air pollution, mean annual exposure (micrograms per cubic meter); `agricultural_land_share` Agricultural land (% of land area); `mobile_subscriptions` Mobile cellular subscriptions (per 100 people); `women_in_parliament` Seats held by women in national parliaments (%)

### Global temperature, monthly

How much warmer or cooler the planet's surface was each month than a long-term average, from NASA, NOAA and Berkeley Earth.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/global-temperature.csv (2,119 rows, 65 KB)
- Keys: month. Covers 1850 to 2026.
- Source: NASA GISTEMP and NOAA Climate at a Glance, via DataHub; Berkeley Earth (https://github.com/datasets/global-temp). Licence: NASA and NOAA columns: US federal data (CC BY 4.0 packaging). Berkeley Earth column: CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial use only.
- Variables: `nasa_anomaly_c` Global temperature against the 1951-1980 average (NASA) (°C); `noaa_anomaly_c` Global temperature against the 20th-century average (NOAA) (°C); `berkeley_anomaly_c` Global temperature against the 1951-1980 average (Berkeley Earth) (°C)

### CO2 in the atmosphere, monthly

The concentration of carbon dioxide in the air, measured at Mauna Loa since 1958 and averaged across the globe since 1979.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/atmospheric-co2.csv (823 rows, 30 KB)
- Keys: month. Covers 1958 to 2026.
- Source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, via DataHub (https://github.com/datasets/co2-ppm). Licence: Public domain (US federal data; PDDL packaging).
- Variables: `mauna_loa_ppm` CO2 at Mauna Loa (parts per million); `mauna_loa_trend_ppm` CO2 at Mauna Loa, seasonal cycle removed (parts per million); `global_ppm` CO2, global average (parts per million); `global_trend_ppm` CO2, global average, seasonal cycle removed (parts per million)

### Earthquakes, past 30 days

Every earthquake of magnitude 2.5 or greater recorded worldwide in the past 30 days, with location, depth and magnitude.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/earthquakes-past-30-days.csv (1,805 rows, 316 KB)
- Keys: id, time. Covers Rolling 30 days.
- Source: US Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `magnitude` Magnitude; `place` Nearest place; `latitude` Latitude (degrees); `longitude` Longitude (degrees); `depth_km` Depth (km); `magnitude_type` Magnitude type; `event_type` Event type; `significance` Significance score (0-1000); `tsunami_flag` Tsunami flag; `felt_reports` Felt reports (reports); `url` USGS event page

### IMF World Economic Outlook: growth, inflation, debt, jobs

The IMF's own figures for every economy, from 1980 to this year. The latest years are estimates.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/imf-world-economic-outlook.csv (10,010 rows, 913 KB)
- Keys: code, year. Covers 1980 to 2026.
- Source: International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outlook (https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/datasets/WEO). Licence: Free to use with attribution (IMF copyright and usage terms).
- Variables: `real_gdp_growth` Real GDP growth (IMF) (% per year); `gdp` GDP, current prices (IMF) (current US$); `gdp_per_person` GDP per person, current prices (IMF) (current US$); `gdp_per_person_ppp` GDP per person, purchasing power parity (IMF) (current international $); `share_of_world_gdp` Share of world GDP, purchasing power parity (IMF) (% of world GDP); `inflation` Inflation, average consumer prices (IMF) (% per year); `inflation_end_of_year` Inflation, end of year (IMF) (% per year); `unemployment_rate` Unemployment rate (IMF) (% of labor force); `population` Population (IMF) (people); `current_account_balance` Current account balance (IMF) (% of GDP); `government_debt` Government gross debt (IMF) (% of GDP); `government_balance` Government net lending or borrowing (IMF) (% of GDP)

### Population, births, deaths and migration since 1950 (UN)

The United Nations' demographic figures for every country: population, age, fertility, life expectancy, deaths and migration.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/un-population.csv (18,326 rows, 2.7 MB)
- Keys: code, year. Covers 1950 to 2026.
- Source: United Nations, World Population Prospects 2024 (https://population.un.org/wpp/). Licence: CC BY 3.0 IGO.

### US medical research projects funded each year

How many research projects the US National Institutes of Health pays for in each fiscal year.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-nih-research-projects.csv (37 rows, 1 KB)
- Keys: date. Covers 1990 to 2026.
- Source: US National Institutes of Health, RePORTER (https://reporter.nih.gov). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `projects_funded` Research projects funded by the US National Institutes of Health (projects)

### US drug and device safety reports and recalls, monthly

Monthly counts of side-effect reports for drugs, problem reports for medical devices, and recalls of drugs, food and devices.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-fda-reports.csv (274 rows, 9 KB)
- Keys: date. Covers 2004 to 2026.
- Source: US Food and Drug Administration, openFDA (https://open.fda.gov). Licence: CC0 (openFDA).
- Variables: `drug_side_effect_reports` US reports of drug side effects received in the month (reports); `device_problem_reports` US reports of medical device problems received in the month (reports); `drug_recalls` US drug recalls reported in the month (recalls); `food_recalls` US food recalls reported in the month (recalls); `device_recalls` US medical device recalls reported in the month (recalls)

### US disaster declarations by year and cause

How many disasters the US government has declared each year since 1953, and what caused them.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-disaster-declarations.csv (74 rows, 4 KB)
- Keys: date. Covers 1953 to 2026.
- Source: Federal Emergency Management Agency, OpenFEMA (https://www.fema.gov/about/openfema). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `all_declarations` US federal disaster declarations in the year (declarations); `major_disasters` US major disaster declarations in the year (declarations); `emergencies` US emergency declarations in the year (declarations); `fire_management` US fire management declarations in the year (declarations); `hurricanes` US disaster declarations for hurricanes and tropical storms (declarations); `floods` US disaster declarations for floods (declarations); `fires` US disaster declarations for fires (declarations); `severe_storms` US disaster declarations for severe storms (declarations); `tornadoes` US disaster declarations for tornadoes (declarations); `winter_storms` US disaster declarations for snow and ice storms (declarations); `earthquakes` US disaster declarations for earthquakes (declarations); `droughts` US disaster declarations for droughts (declarations); `biological` US disaster declarations for biological events (such as COVID-19) (declarations); `other` US disaster declarations for other causes (declarations)

### Every US disaster declaration since 1953

One line for each federally declared disaster, with its date, state, type and name.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-disaster-declarations-list.csv (5,286 rows, 297 KB)
- Keys: disaster_number. Covers 1953 to 2026.
- Source: Federal Emergency Management Agency, OpenFEMA (https://www.fema.gov/about/openfema). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `declared` Declared; `state` State or territory; `declaration_type` Declaration type; `incident_type` Cause; `name` Name of the disaster

### US federal rules and executive orders, by year

How much the US government regulates: final rules, proposed rules, presidential documents and executive orders published in the Federal Register each year since 1995.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-federal-register.csv (32 rows, 1 KB)
- Keys: date. Covers 1995 to 2026.
- Source: US National Archives, Federal Register (https://www.federalregister.gov). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `final_rules` US federal final rules published in the year (documents); `proposed_rules` US federal proposed rules published in the year (documents); `presidential_documents` US presidential documents published in the year (documents); `executive_orders` US executive orders published in the year (orders)

### US federal spending by agency, this fiscal year

What each federal agency may spend, has committed and has paid out in the current fiscal year.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-federal-spending-by-agency.csv (111 rows, 10 KB)
- Keys: agency, fiscal_year. Covers 2026.
- Source: US Treasury, USAspending.gov (https://www.usaspending.gov/agency). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `budget_authority` Budget authority (current US$); `obligations` Obligations (current US$); `outlays` Outlays (current US$); `share_of_federal_budget` Share of total federal budget authority (% of the total)

### US bank failures by year

How many banks failed in the United States each year since 1934, and how large they were.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-bank-failures.csv (93 rows, 2 KB)
- Keys: date. Covers 1934 to 2026.
- Source: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, BankFind (https://banks.data.fdic.gov). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `bank_failures` US bank failures in the year (banks); `assets_of_failed_banks` Assets of US banks that failed in the year (current US$)

### Every US bank failure since 1934

One line for each failed bank: date, name, place, assets, deposits and the estimated cost to the insurance fund.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/us-bank-failures-list.csv (4,117 rows, 349 KB)
- Keys: id. Covers 1934 to 2026.
- Source: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, BankFind (https://banks.data.fdic.gov). Licence: Public domain (US federal data).
- Variables: `failed` Failed; `bank` Bank; `city_and_state` City and state; `assets` Assets at failure (current US$); `deposits` Deposits at failure (current US$); `estimated_cost` Estimated cost to the insurance fund (current US$); `resolution` How it was resolved

- Keys: date. Covers 2012 to 2026.
- Source: NYC Open Data, New York Police Department (https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Public-Safety/Motor-Vehicle-Collisions-Crashes/h9gi-nx95). Licence: NYC Open Data terms of use (free to use).
- Variables: `crashes` New York City: motor vehicle crashes in the month (crashes); `people_injured` New York City: people injured in crashes in the month (people); `people_killed` New York City: people killed in crashes in the month (people); `pedestrians_killed` New York City: pedestrians killed in crashes in the month (people); `cyclists_killed` New York City: cyclists killed in crashes in the month (people)

### PJM summer peak load: forecasts and actuals by zone

Summer peak demand for each PJM transmission zone: the forecasts published in January 2025 and January 2026, with metered and weather-normalized actual peaks for 2024 and 2025.

- File: https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/data/sets/pjm-summer-peak-forecasts.csv (621 rows, 15 KB)
- Keys: zone, year. Covers 2024 to 2046.
- Source: PJM Load Forecast Reports, January 2025 and 2026 (https://www.pjm.com/planning/resource-adequacy-planning/load-forecast-dev-process). Licence: Public PJM report tables; check PJM's terms before commercial redistribution.
- Variables: `forecast_jan2025_mw` Summer peak forecast, January 2025 report (MW); `forecast_jan2026_mw` Summer peak forecast, January 2026 report (MW); `metered_peak_mw` Metered summer peak (MW); `normalized_peak_mw` Weather-normalized summer peak (MW)

## Pages for people

- [Data AI](https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/ask.html): ask a question by typing or by voice; the answer gives the number with its year and source
- [Datasets](https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/datasets.html): every dataset and variable
- [Explorer](https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/explore.html): choose variables, places and years, then download
- [Researcher mode](https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/research.html): test a hypothesis on the data
- [Your data](https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/mydata.html): open your own file in the browser and analyse it
- [Updates](https://sahiljangra12.github.io/open-data-company/updates.html): refresh times and what changed
